mapper.select: SELECT m.MEDICINE_CODE, m.ITEM_SEQ, m.MEDICINE_CATEGORY, m.MEDICINE_NAME, m.MANUFACTURER, m.SPECIFICATION, m.INGREDIENT, m.UNIT, m.COVERAGE_YN, m.UNIT_COST, m.INSURANCE_FEE, m.CONTRIBUTION, m.CURRENT_QUANTITY, m.MIN_QUANTITY, cm.CODENAME_1 AS medicineNameText, cc.CODENAME_1 AS medicineCategoryName, cu.CODENAME_1 AS unitName FROM MEDICINE m LEFT JOIN COMMONCODE cm ON m.MEDICINE_NAME = cm.COMMONCODE_NUMBER AND cm.COMMONCODE = 'M' LEFT JOIN COMMONCODE cc ON m.MEDICINE_CATEGORY = cc.COMMONCODE_NUMBER AND cc.COMMONCODE = 'C' LEFT JOIN COMMONCODE cu ON m.UNIT = cu.COMMONCODE_NUMBER AND cu.COMMONCODE = 'U' WHERE m.CURRENT_QUANTITY < m.MIN_QUANTITY ORDER BY m.MEDICINE_CODE

SELECT m.MEDICINE_CODE, m.ITEM_SEQ, m.MEDICINE_CATEGORY, m.MEDICINE_NAME, m.MANUFACTURER, m.SPECIFICATION, m.INGREDIENT, m.UNIT, m.COVERAGE_YN, m.UNIT_COST, m.INSURANCE_FEE, m.CONTRIBUTION, m.CURRENT_QUANTITY, m.MIN_QUANTITY, cm.CODENAME_1 AS medicineNameText, cc.CODENAME_1 AS medicineCategoryName, cu.CODENAME_1 AS unitName FROM MEDICINE m LEFT JOIN COMMONCODE cm ON m.MEDICINE_NAME = cm.COMMONCODE_NUMBER AND cm.COMMONCODE = 'M' LEFT JOIN COMMONCODE cc ON m.MEDICINE_CATEGORY = cc.COMMONCODE_NUMBER AND cc.COMMONCODE = 'C' LEFT JOIN COMMONCODE cu ON m.UNIT = cu.COMMONCODE_NUMBER AND cu.COMMONCODE = 'U' ORDER BY m.MEDICINE_CODE
